title: Spec-driven changes with OpenSpec
summary: The convention for keeping current behaviour in openspec/specs/ and work in flight in openspec/changes/ (propose, apply, archive), plus a guard that validates them. The OpenSpec CLI generates its own commands and skills.
postInstall: Install the OpenSpec CLI at a pinned version (the convention was written against @fission-ai/openspec 1.10.0) and run `openspec init` in the project.
Commit what it generates (.claude/commands/opsx/, .claude/skills/openspec-*) and never hand-edit those files: `openspec update` regenerates them.
If the agents module is installed, add the validation command to .claude/hooks/agent-bash-guard.config.json so the verifier can run it.
